# DeepSeek V4 Pro (MXFP4) on H200 (SXM) x8 — SGLang, TP8 on all 8 GPUs, flashinfer_mxfp4 MoE, DSpark speculative decoding (draft
# head bundled in the checkpoint).
# Weights: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 @ 72e1d3230f6c080a530b0a1d46f8eb4602340597
# Image: lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.19-cu130
docker run -d \
  --gpus all \
  --ipc=host --shm-size=32g --network host \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 --ulimit nofile=65536:65536 \
  -v <host-path>:/cache \
  -e HF_HOME=/cache \
  -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
  --entrypoint bash \
  lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.19-cu130 \
  -c "exec python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 \
    --served-model-name deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 \
    --host 127.0.0.1 \
    --port 30000 \
    --tool-call-parser deepseekv4 \
    --reasoning-parser deepseek-v4 \
    --enable-metrics \
    --enable-cache-report \
    --tp 8 \
    --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 \
    --speculative-algorithm DSPARK \
    --mem-fraction-static 0.88 \
    --chunked-prefill-size 4096"

# DeepSeek V4 Pro (MXFP4) on B200 (SXM) x8 — SGLang, TP8 + DP8 attention + EP8 (MegaMoE, W4A4 MXFP4), DP LM head, DSpark
# speculative decoding (block size 6), FP4 indexer, HiCache host-DRAM KV tier (ratio 8, write-through, direct IO). SGLang
# v0.5.21 cookbook DeepSeek-V4 "Agentic Long-Context with HiCache DRAM Offload (B200 FP4, DSpark)" DEP8 settings, unchanged,
# plus cache reporting and metrics; the cookbook's --attn-dp-size 8 is written as --dp-size 8 --enable-dp-attention for v0.5.21.
# Weights: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 @ 72e1d3230f6c080a530b0a1d46f8eb4602340597
# Image: lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21
docker run -d \
  --gpus '"device=<8 GPUs>"' \
  --ipc=host --shm-size=32g --network host \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  -v <host-path>:/hub:ro \
  -e SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=900 \
  -e SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=8320 \
  --entrypoint sglang \
  lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21 serve \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --tp 8 \
    --dp-size 8 \
    --enable-dp-attention \
    --enable-dp-lm-head \
    --ep-size 8 \
    --moe-a2a-backend megamoe \
    --enable-w4a4-mxfp4-megamoe \
    --enable-deepseek-v4-fp4-indexer \
    --disable-shared-experts-fusion \
    --disable-flashinfer-autotune \
    --mem-fraction-static 0.88 \
    --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.02 \
    --chunked-prefill-size 49152 \
    --tool-call-parser deepseekv4 \
    --reasoning-parser deepseek-v4 \
    --speculative-algorithm DSPARK \
    --speculative-dspark-block-size 6 \
    --enable-hierarchical-cache \
    --hicache-ratio 8 \
    --hicache-write-policy write_through \
    --hicache-io-backend direct \
    --hicache-mem-layout page_first_direct \
    --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 \
    --served-model-name deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 \
    --enable-cache-report \
    --enable-metrics \
    --host 127.0.0.1 \
    --port 30000

record.launchCommand:
# DeepSeek V4 Pro (MXFP4) on B200 (SXM) x8 — vLLM 0.31.0, TP8 on all 8 GPUs, DSpark speculative decoding (7 tokens,
# probabilistic draft). vLLM recipes DeepSeek V4 Pro single-node TP settings for Blackwell (0813 variant): FP8 KV cache,
# block size 256, deepseek_v4 tokenizer and parsers, MXFP4 indexer KV, FlashInfer autotune off; plus prompt-token details
# in usage reporting and vLLM --numa-bind (workers and EngineCore on their GPU's NUMA node).
# Weights: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 @ 72e1d3230f6c080a530b0a1d46f8eb4602340597
# Image: vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0 (vLLM 0.31.0, CUDA 13.0)
docker run -d \
  --gpus '"device=<8 GPUs>"' \
  --ipc=host \
  --shm-size=32g \
  --network host \
  --ulimit memlock=-1 \
  -v <host-path>:/hub:ro \
  -e VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600 \
  --entrypoint vllm \
  vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0 \
  serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 \
    --served-model-name deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 \
    --host 127.0.0.1 \
    --port 30000 \
    --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
    --block-size 256 \
    --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v4 \
    --tool-call-parser deepseek_v4 \
    --enable-auto-tool-choice \
    --reasoning-parser deepseek_v4 \
    --attention_config.indexer_kv_dtype=mxfp4 \
    --no-enable-flashinfer-autotune \
    --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic"}' \
    --enable-prompt-tokens-details \
    --numa-bind \
    --numa-bind-nodes 0 0 0 0 1 1 1 1
